sections.title: Reusable lunch boxes
sections.transcript:
HOST: You work on reusable lunch boxes. What got your team started? People often think projects like yours begin with a large grant.

GUEST: Ours started with staff suggestions. At the time our biggest obstacle was washing costs. We had to change the plan before we could make proper progress.

HOST: What surprised you once you started getting results?

GUEST: We discovered high returns. It helped us improve collection points. That wasn't a goal we had written into the original proposal.

HOST: And what happens next?

GUEST: We'll trial the scheme at a second site. Then we'll decide whether to expand.
